title: Isolation of Human Buccal Cells for Single-Cell Applications
author: Buranapraditkun, Rodsaward, et al.

steps.title: Obtain IRB‑approved buccal biopsy
steps.instruction: Collect human buccal tissue under an Institutional Review Board‑approved clinical protocol with informed consent from the donor.

steps.title: Place tissue in cold wash medium
steps.instruction: Transfer the buccal tissue into a sterile 50 mL conical tube containing 25 mL pre‑cooled (4 °C) wash medium (RPMI 1640 supplemented with 1× Antibiotic‑Antimycotic) and transport on ice to the laboratory within 30 minutes of collection.

steps.title: Verify reagent stock availability
steps.instruction: Confirm that all stock solutions and reagents listed in the Materials and Equipment section are on hand before beginning the procedure.

steps.title: Work in Class II biosafety cabinet
steps.instruction: Perform all tissue‑processing and reagent‑preparation steps inside a Class II biosafety cabinet to maintain sterility and operator safety.

steps.title: Preheat incubator shaker
steps.instruction: Set the incubator shaker to 37 °C and allow it to reach temperature before starting enzymatic digestion.

steps.title: Pre‑cool refrigerated centrifuge
steps.instruction: Cool the refrigerated centrifuge equipped with a 50 mL tube rotor to 4 °C prior to any centrifugation steps.

steps.title: Prepare fresh digestion buffers
steps.instruction: Make fresh digestion buffer and tissue‑culture medium on the day of the experiment according to the recipes in the key resources table.

steps.title: Record sample information
steps.instruction: In the biosafety cabinet (maintained at 25 °C), record the sample ID and the exact time of tissue collection.

steps.title: Prepare collagenase digestion medium
steps.instruction: Immediately before use, add 500 µL collagenase IV and 20 µL Benzonase to 25 mL of wash medium to create the Collagenase Digestion Medium.

steps.title: Decant excess wash medium
steps.instruction: Gently decant the wash medium from the biopsy tube, leaving approximately 1.5 mL to keep the tissue submerged.

steps.title: Rinse tissue with wash medium
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL of wash medium to the tube to rinse the tissue, then gently remove the liquid, again leaving about 1.5 mL to maintain the buccal tissue.

steps.title: Transfer tissue to petri dish
steps.instruction: Move the buccal tissue to a sterile petri dish, record its weight, and keep the dish on the bench.

steps.title: Mince tissue into small pieces
steps.instruction: Using a sterile scalpel or scissors, mince the buccal tissue into pieces approximately 1–2 mm³ in size.

steps.title: Transfer minced tissue to digestion tube
steps.instruction: Place the minced tissue into a 50 mL tube that already contains 25 mL of the prepared Collagenase Digestion Medium.
